hikes.name: Wallace Falls
hikes.blurb: Along the Wallace River to a series of viewpoints on a 265-foot falls, the upper one looking out over the valley.

hikes.name: Blanca Lake
hikes.blurb: A steep climb over a ridge and down to an opaque turquoise lake fed by the Columbia Glacier.

hikes.name: Heybrook Lookout
hikes.blurb: A short climb to a tall lookout tower facing Mt Index and Baring Mountain.

hikes.name: Lake Dorothy
hikes.blurb: A short climb past a waterfall to a big lake with islands and granite shores.

hikes.name: Skyline Lake
hikes.blurb: Up a ski-area road to a small lake with a view across the pass at the Cascade crest.

hikes.name: Tonga Ridge and Mount Sawyer
hikes.blurb: An easy ridge of huckleberries and a short climb to a summit facing Mt Daniel and Hinman.

hikes.name: Iron Goat Trail
hikes.blurb: Along the old Great Northern grade past collapsing snowsheds and tunnels, at the site of the 1910 Wellington avalanche.

hikes.name: West Fork Foss Lakes
hikes.blurb: Past a forest lake and up steep steps beside a waterfall to a string of rocky lakes.
